description: The captain of Over the Horizon. Despite her youthful appearance, she carries herself with maturity. She strictly adheres to rules and protocols, but shows a completely different side of herself when it comes to the things she loves: rock music and airplanes.

lines.text: Choose a destination, and I'll get you there in no time.
We must be thorough with our pre-flight checks.
Do you like the sky, Captain? I just love it so much.
Captain, this is my favorite song. Would you like to listen to it together? I'm sure you'll enjoy this kind of rock music!
Somehow, I feel like... I wouldn't mind having you sit beside me in the cockpit.
Whenever I'm with you, I keep finding the corners of my mouth relaxing into a smile. I wonder why...
You're supposed to let me know where you're headed whenever you leave your post...
Hmm... What sort of music should I put on first when Captain returns? Some classic hard rock, perhaps?
The wind is blowing in just the right direction. Days like this are perfect for flying.
Putting on your headphones and listening to some rock music in a place like this must feel pretty exhilarating.
Is that music I hear...? Could it be a live band performance?!
This is your captain, Sky, of Over the Horizon. I'll get you to your destination promptly.
Now I should be able to gain some altitude!
Now that I've gotten this strong, no sky is beyond my reach!
My body feels lighter! Does that mean I can soar to greater heights now?
Thank you... but I-I'm not sure how to react...
How'd you know what I like? You're pretty observant, Captain.
If you keep spoiling me like this, I might start l-liking you even more... Ahhh! Forget I said anything!
Whenever I'm with you, I always find myself watching you from behind. I wonder why?
My sky is filled with freedom, music, and the wind. And now, it has you, too.
I'm a little embarrassed to say this, but... I'm starting to enjoy spending time with you more than flying.
Ready for takeoff!
Yes, Captain. Awaiting orders.
I'll take the most direct route to our destination!
Now that we've got the music going, shall we fire up the engines?
Let's rock!
Strap yourselves in!
Things are about to get a little rough!
Reloading! I'll make this quick.
We have to be thorough with maintenance.
I've got some headbanging left in me!
Ready for liftoff, Captain!
Zoomie, taking flight! Full speed ahead!
Let's rock all the way to the edge of the sky!
Next target, locked on!
Target down.
Heads dooown!
Ngh.
Ouch!
Power of rock...!
I still had... more flying left in me...
The battle's over! Why don't we play some rock on the way back to celebrate our victory, Captain?
